fact: The 26 November 2025 report says contracts for the FGS Integrated Tax Administration System were signed after the September 2025 mid-term review, and online filing of income and sales tax by large taxpayers stood at 0% at 31 October 2025 (target 80% by December 2027), awaiting ITAS.
